text:
sara: FYI - discovered a crash in tokenizer on long prompt paths in eu-west1. Repro rate ~6%% on prod traffic, causing downstream 502s. Need an expedited pin + hotfix deploy window tonight. Can we get approvals?

omar: pinging infra. severity looks high, agree we should pin and roll forward. What rollback guardrails do we need? :eyes:

miriam: oncall checking traces now. If we deploy, set canary at 5%% for 10m and health checks for 2m before widening. Also enable auto-rollback on >1%% error delta.

deploy-bot: Deploy check: image tokenizer-v2.1.3-hotfix available. CI: green. Canary smoke: passed locally. Required approvals: release-lead, oncall, platform.

jen: +1 from oncall if miriam is comfortable. Will monitor logs and open a quick channel.

kevin: quick note - this hotfix changes tokenization fallback behavior, should be low-risk. We tested edgecases in staging but not full perf. Recommend adding a short traffic limit and disable batching to reduce blast radius.

sara: Agreed. Planned steps: 1) pin runtime to tokenizer-v2.1.3-hotfix 2) deploy canary 5%% for 10m with batching disabled 3) verify latency and 502s 4) widen to 25%% then 100%% if clean. If any regression -> immediate rollback.

omar: Approve for expedite. I need the release notes snip to add to pagerlog.

sara: Release notes: "Fixes long-prompt tokenizer crash causing 502s under specific tokenization fallback. Backward-compatible. Rolling pin to tokenizer-v2.1.3-hotfix."

miriam: +1 from SRE. I'll watch dashboards. If error-rate increases by >0.5pp over baseline for 5m, we rollback.

deploy-bot: Approval recorded: sara, omar, miriam. Initiating canary at 2026-03-20T22:00:00Z. Canary config: 5%% traffic, batching: disabled, health-check window: 120s.

deploy-bot: Canary progress: 2m - no errors, latency within baseline. 8m remaining.

jen: logs look stable, no 502 spikes. throttling metrics ok.

deploy-bot: Canary progress: 10m - pass. Widening to 25%%.

kevin: Monitoring A/B traces. Token mismatch metric down. Good signal.

deploy-bot: Widen to 25%% complete. Monitoring 15m.

miriam: 10m into 25%%, still stable. Proceed when ready.

omar: final approve for full roll. Sara, you good to go 100%%?

sara: Go for it. Rolling to 100%% now.

deploy-bot: Rollout: 100%% complete. Post-deploy checks running.

deploy-bot: Post-deploy: 20m - health stable, no elevated error rate.

sara: Thanks all. Followups: add regression test for long-prompt tokenizer case, and schedule a postmortem doc later this week. If we need to rollback manually: use

```
./deploy rollback --service tokenizer --to tokenizer-v2.1.2
```

sara: tagging here for record: @product, @security (for release notes). :white_check_mark:
